services.desc: Salmon Shark- SeaSport 2700 Navigator Layout: Forward cuddy cabin with v-berth and seating for seven in comfortable and warm cabin with table as well as a spacious and private head. Anchoring is made easy with a capstan winch and a pot puller makes quick work of shrimping. Electronics include a JRC Radar, Garman mapping GPS, and a Standard Horizon VHF. As with all of our vessels, a net, gaff, and harpoon are supplied. USCG safety requirements are exceeded. Power: Salmon Shark is powered with a single fuel efficient Volvo Penta diesel engine coupled to a duoprop sterndrive. services.name: Meagan Anne
services.desc: Layout: Large forward V-berth with bunk space for four adults. A captain seat starboard and forward port side seat plus a dinette provide seating for up to seven. The dinette converts into a bed suitable for one or two adults. Electronics include a Garmin touchscreen GPS/sounder, and a pair of VHF radios. A bullet proof Dickinson diesel heater/oven as well as a forced air diesel heater will keep things warm and dry. The Meagan Anne has a freshwater sink, enclosed head, shore dinghy, anchor with 300’ of rode, and tons of storage space. All USCG required equipment is onboard.
